Thank you for this opportunity. I would describe myself as a positive, responsible, and hardworking person. I graduated from Istanbul University, Department of Aviation Technology.

Currently, I work as a customer relations associate at a software company, where I have developed valuable skills such as communication, problem-solving, and the ability to deal with different types of people in a professional way.

In my free time, I enjoy being active. I like playing basketball and cycling, which help me stay energetic and disciplined.

As a result of all these experiences, I am very motivated to start my career as a cabin crew member and contribute to Riyadh Air.
